name: [[644,46,8]] periodic bivariate-bicycle on Z_23 x Z_14

provenance.construction: Periodic bivariate-bicycle code on the group algebra Z_23 x Z_14 (n = 2*l*m = 644). Convention: x = S_23 tensor I_14, y = I_23 tensor S_14 (cyclic shifts), qubit index = i*m + j; A = 1 + x^0y^11 + x^7y^2 + x^7y^8, B = 1 + x^0y^1; H_X = [A|B], H_Z = [B^T|A^T]. Found by an automated evolutionary/mutation search over (l, m, A, B) exponent sets targeting the unrestricted x weight-6 (or weight-8) board cells, screened by a randomized lightest-logical surrogate and promoted through increasing trial budgets.
